site.sitedescription: Sedge fen located behind a low ridge a few meters above the southeastern shore of Lago Pollux. A dense shrub belt of Nothofagus antarctica and Escallonia rubra covers the drier areas of the fen. Native Nothofagus pumilio forest has been mostly cleared and converted to pastureland.
